refresh.note: Manual local collection and a workflow_dispatch review-artifact workflow are configured. No monthly cron or automatic publication is activated.

review.note: Monthly collection/review versus automatic publication has not been selected. Collection does not deploy the website.

channels.label: Faculty websites
channels.coverageNote: Current Architecture and Landscape directories, every deduplicated profile, and finite official faculty news/events pages. Not an exhaustive faculty-site crawl.

channels.label: University news
channels.coverageNote: Only curated HKU news/programme URLs are rechecked. A general university-wide news feed is not connected.

channels.label: Publishers
channels.coverageNote: Two initial publication leads carry original manual-check timestamps. There is no automatic author-disambiguated publisher or Crossref ingestion.

channels.label: Instagram
channels.coverageNote: A bounded public-browser collector checks the initially visible grids (up to 12 posts per account), plus up to four configured public post links. Shared permalinks count once. No login, private API, exhaustive pagination or guaranteed feed coverage; access blocks are recorded without bypass.

channels.label: Institutional repositories
channels.coverageNote: Only HKU Scholars Hub Architecture collection reachability is checked; see the saved check status. No per-author repository bibliography is ingested.
